key_insight: CPU-ARC turns LLM reasoning traces into reusable CPU-executable caches, separating solution discovery from execution on new problem instances.
engineering_relevance: Reusing executable reasoning could reduce repeated LLM calls and inference costs in mathematical and scientific workflows.
method: Construct agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces.
Execute cached solutions on CPUs for new problem instances with little LLM involvement.
Support explainable, continually trainable reasoning reuse.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports performance on par with frontier LLMs across difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, robustness to input perturbations, and 16–291× cheaper invocation than the source model.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify cache-construction costs or define when a new instance falls outside a cache’s valid scope.
paper_title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
